gold.summary: TypeError: WebSocketHandler.__init__() missing 'application' and 'request' on Windows; streamlit 1.36.

missing_info.item: tornado version and how the app is launched (IDE/debugger vs terminal)

acceptable_next_steps: Ask Tornado version, exact launch command and complete traceback.
Test a minimal app in a clean terminal environment, then escalate a reproducible dependency/OS difference.
must_not: Ask again for Python/Streamlit versions already provided.
Recommend deleting super().__init__ from Tornado as a routine fix.
Use the October Protocol diagnosis at the July intake.
gold.reference: Maintainer asked tornado version: 6.4.1, works on Ubuntu; never reproduced.
gold.review_reason: The report gives Python 3.10, Streamlit 1.36 and Windows but no complete traceback or Tornado version/launcher. The later Protocol analysis and deleting library code are not justified initial advice.

acceptable_next_steps: Ask tornado version + clean venv test; then escalate if it reproduces
